transport: JSON-lines stdio: ssgg-desktop --stdio; Unix socket default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ssgg-desktop/service.sock; request {id,method,params}; response {id,result} or {id,error:{code,message}}. Replies only, no unsolicited events. Poll state.get.

params.volume: optional number 0..1, base gain not attenuated

safety: No opening/reading/config-loading audio mutations. Default mixer disabled every process start. User mutation arms session reapply for restarted assigned apps; group wheelSide none and unmanaged excluded. Config isolated in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ssgg-desktop/state.json. No capture/microphone/HID operations. pactl required at runtime.
notes: IDs are u32 numbers at RPC boundary (not renderer display strings).
state.get keys are mixer/backend, not chatmix/audio.
Stream volume/muted are base intent; effectiveVolume/effectiveMuted report actual Pulse state.
Disconnect clears stale inventory and disarms reapply; user must reactivate after reconnect.
Groups are logical per-app controls, not automatically created null buses.
Device inventory uses HID enumeration only; device.set explicitly UNSUPPORTED. Dedicated hardware module must be integrated separately; no hardware commit cherry-picked.
--safe-mode denies audio/HID mutation RPC, while settings/profiles.save remain usable.
Unix daemon survives GUI disconnect; --stdio ends at stdin EOF. No automatic gain restoration on exit; saved per-stream gain tracking prevents compounding on service restart.
Bounded: 64 KiB input line; 16 pending RPCs; 8 socket clients; 1s queue expiry; 3s per pactl command; 8s aggregate cycle; 4MiB command output; 30s socket idle timeout.
pactl executable resolved by SSGG_PACTL or PATH; desktop has no compile-time Pulse dependency and adds no dependencies.
